11.6  The Owner may only terminate this Agreement with the written consent of the Licensee.
findings.explanation: You can only terminate the agreement if the client consents, which gives the client control over your right to end the contract.
findings.suggested_change: Both the Owner and the Licensee may terminate this Agreement upon written notice to the other parties.
